title: fix: move Enter leaderboard prompt outside card
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Moved the quest prompt below the Enter leaderboard card, removed its divider, and matched its styling to the existing quest notes.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden hackerspace, Polli points to a quest note placed just below a leaderboard card on a glowing lime green (#ecf874) CRT screen, with small pixel flowers growing around the desk. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny reading glasses; she is small within the scene, beside chunky retro sprites and soft pastel gradients. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
